{{dablink|For the reservoir of ''[[saidin]]'', see [[Eye of the World]]. For other uses of the words "eye" and "world," see [[Eye]] and [[World]].}}
'''''The Eye of the World'' comic''' is based of the book with [[The Eye of the World|the same name]].  The first issue, called Dragonmount (''The Wheel of Time'': ''Eye of the World'' #0), was released on April 29, 2009. New issues came out monthly through Dabel Brothers Publishing. It was written and drawn by Chuck Dixon and Chase Conley. As of 2013, [[Dynamite Entertainment]] produced it on a monthly basis.
